fieldguide.entity.gipples_galore.aneuplo: A Hostile beast thought to have been excinct for thousands of years, Aneuploidiands are a past iteration of Gipples. It is unknown why they take a different form today, or what this form could accomplish if left unchecked.
Small, gloopy creatures native to deep caverns, typically under oceans or colder terrain. 

They can hide in the yummy gelatin they produce by eating Glow Lichen. When fed too much though, they can split into 2 gipples through gipplification...

Or something else...
